headline: Trump Replaces Chief of Staff with Stephen Miller Following Midterms
summary: US President Donald Trump announced that his chief of staff will leave her post, to be replaced by hardline deputy Stephen Miller, following the Republican Party's midterm election performance.
why: Changes in senior White House staff signal shifts in administrative priorities, legislative strategy, and policy execution, which can drive volatility across regulated sectors and broader financial markets.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Shifts in executive branch leadership affect federal policy implementation.
